name: Missha All Around Safe Block Soft Finish Sun Milk SPF50+ Or PA+++
description:
Product Name: Missha All Around Safe Block Soft Finish Sun Milk
SPF/PA Rating: SPF50+/PA+++

Key Features

Soft Finish: Provides a matte, smooth texture for a flawless look

Moisturizing Formula: Enriched with skin-loving ingredients to keep skin hydrated

Non-Irritating: Safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin

Silky Porous Powder: Creates a smooth base for makeup application

Tone Correction: Helps even out the skin’s natural tone and texture

Water & Sweat Resistant: Long-lasting protection for daily outdoor activities

Lightweight & Refreshing: Comfortable for everyday use

UV Protection: Shields skin from harmful UVA & UVB rays
